concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Actual concept pixels inspected and retained. REJECT its modern fern-like separate twigs, dominant long midrib and decorative matrix cracks. Replace with closely packed opposing flattened first-order lobate modules, each containing integrated smaller repeated divisions, separated by shallow negative grooves. Narrow subdued central axis and no leaf stalk. Original shallow relief rises at most about3mm above nominal9mm matrix and extends toward both pointed ends, not voluminous biconvex animal. Tight hierarchy remains readable in top/clay at512px. Source Article Methods explicitly cautions unsupported high relief. One closed original heightfield/matrix mesh, not stacked coplanar fossil surfaces.
